GAP-002.description: 典型设备名称, 规格型号, 序号 incorrectly filled with '详见设备清单'
GAP-002.resolution: 典型设备名称=保护架, 规格型号=blank (empty), 序号=1
GAP-002.root_cause: Fill logic was using '详见设备清单' as fallback when Sheet2 values were empty

GAP-004.description: 存放地点, 存放情况, 具体存放位置 not mapped
GAP-004.resolution: These columns do NOT exist in Sheet2; leave placeholders blank
GAP-004.root_cause: Columns were never present in the source workbook

key_learning: The '详见设备清单' fallback text was being incorrectly applied when Sheet2 source values were empty strings, rather than leaving placeholders truly blank. The fix requires: (1) non-empty source → use value, (2) empty source → leave blank, (3) missing column → leave blank.
